Watts printed the hymn under Ecclesiastes 12:1, 7, 20. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1Remember your Creator in the days of your youth, before the days of adversity come and the years approach of which you will say, “I find no pleasure in them,” 7before the dust returns to the ground from which it came and the spirit returns to God who gave it.
